title: S4 Identity, Revision, Suitability & State Dimensions

entries.name: Identity
entries.definition: Stable root identifier of the governed container or object. Canonical cross-platform root identity follows the seven-token hyphen grammar and excludes mutable lifecycle dimensions.

entries.name: Revision
entries.definition: Controlled change/version sequence such as preliminary, shared milestone, or contractual revision. Revision is associated metadata and does not redefine root identity.

entries.name: Suitability / Permitted Use
entries.definition: Declared permitted use or reliance status such as S0, S1, S2, S3, S4, A1, A2, or B1 where applicable. Suitability is associated metadata and does not redefine root identity.

entries.name: CDE Platform State
entries.definition: Governed storage or information state such as WIP, Shared, Published, Archived or coordination placement. CDE state does not redefine root identity.

entries.name: Coordination Issue State
entries.definition: Operational coordination issue lifecycle state, separate from container identity and delivery status.

rules: These dimensions shall not be flattened into a single state system or treated as interchangeable identity tokens.
Revision and suitability/status shall not form part of canonical root container identity.
Platform-specific labels may display mutable dimensions only where required, while preserving an unchanged canonical root identity mapping.
